policyReview.message: UMGC’s bachelor’s degree requirements set no degree-wide upper-level minimum. Their only upper-level rule is 15 upper-level credits (courses numbered 300 to 499) completed at UMGC. This plan’s named upper-level courses with no outside option total 36 credits, so it meets that rule.
